limits: Mechanical geometry and closure checks do not prove anatomy, identity, pose originality or animation quality.
Automatic anchors are geometric estimates until visual review confirms feet and alignment.
Exact translation/reflection/rotation duplicates are rejected; near-copies and arbitrary affine copies require visual review.
GIF timing is a rounded review preview; runtime uses the exact 12/40 phase contract.
Source draft files and generated sheets are references; only reviewed final HD art is eligible for publication.

review.reviewer: Codex root visual review 2026-10-09; A3 design approved by user
review.notes: Inspected all four 13-pose contact sheets, full-size normalized DOWN05, all DOWN generation results, and first/last poses for cyclic continuity; direction agents inspected every full-size generated frame. Kept fixed directional canvas baseline so stepping feet do not drag the head laterally. Same recognizable approved palette, headband, paired decoration and costume; no missing limbs, cropped silhouettes or extra weapon. LEFT03 and DOWN05 replaced rejected phase drawings; RIGHT10 and UP06 regenerated by their authors. Small hand-drawn silhouette and head-height changes remain; exact source pixels are provided separately in original mode. A3 in-game 36/37-world-pixel scale retained; final actual HD GPU occlusion and long-run validation are A5/A6 gates, not claimed here.
